description: Source code for F1AP test mode adapter handling F1 setup, UE creation, and message interception in a 5G network simulation environment.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class that intercepts and modifies F1AP messages for testing purposes, implementing both f1ap_du and f1c_connection_client interfaces.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter::f1ap_to_gw_pdu_interceptor
classes.description: Intercepts F1AP PDUs sent from the F1AP-DU to the F1-C gateway, allowing message modification or inspection.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter::gw_to_f1ap_pdu_interceptor
classes.description: Intercepts PDUs sent from the gateway to the F1AP-DU, forwarding messages unchanged.

methods.name: handle_du_connection_request
methods.description: Handles incoming DU connection requests, wrapping the notifier with an interceptor for message handling.

methods.name: create_du_high_f1ap
methods.description: Factory function that creates a high-level F1AP DU, wrapping it with a test mode adapter if test configuration is provided.
